text:
Claire H.: quick note — our onboarding CLI (`rdw-cli v0.6.2`) produced duplicate workspace objects when the auth token rotated mid-batch. Repro is easy locally with 4 parallel runners.

Omar S.: can you paste minimal repro steps and logs? wondering if this is CLI-only or SDK parity gap.

Claire H.: repro:
  1) `rdw-cli onboarding --batch 500 --concurrency 4 --seed 13`
  2) trigger auth rotation `authctl rotate-now` at t=2s
  3) watch many 429s then immediate retries

Log snippet from a single runner:
```
WARN 2026-04-08T10:12:03Z retry: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=10 jitter_ms=0
INFO 2026-04-08T10:12:03Z client: outgoing POST /v1/workspaces Idempotency-Key=(none)
INFO 2026-04-08T10:12:03Z retry: retrying attempt=2 backoff_ms=10 jitter_ms=0
ERROR 2026-04-08T10:12:03Z workspace: created duplicate ws_7c2f
```

Claire H.: note CLI uses go-sdk under the hood but our onboarding script defaulted to not set idempotency. node sampleapp (which does set it) did not show duplicates.

Omar S.: two hypotheses: (A) go-sdk not auto-inserting idempotency when CLI omits; (B) jitter/min_backoff too small -> synchronized retries during token swap.

DevQA: confirmed that when we flip CLI to pass `--idempotency-template 'cli-<pid>-<ts>-<rand6>'` duplicates go away.

Omar S.: proposed changes:
  - CLI: opt-in flag `--auto-idempotency` default OFF for backwards compatibility, but we should flip to ON for onboarding workflows. When enabled, CLI will add header `Idempotency-Key: rdw.cli.<instanceid>.<mono>` and header `X-Redwood-Idemp-Origin: cli-auto`.
  - go-sdk: add opt-in `SDK_AUTO_IDEMP=true` env and a safer default for hosted images. When SDK generates a key, emit header `X-Redwood-Idemp-Generated: true` for debugging.
  - jitter: switch default retry jitter to `full-jitter` and bump min_backoff to 50ms for SDK-runner processes. Expose `REDWOOD_SDK_BACKOFF_POLICY=full|equal|none` for testing.

Claire H.: +1 to full-jitter. Also recommend a short client-side monotonic counter appended to idemp keys so retries from same process are unique and ordered (helps correlate).

Omar S.: agree. we'll implement `instanceid` as uuid per process and `mono` as uint32 incremented atomically. For short-lived CLI runs the counter resets on process start which is fine.

BuildBot: CI pipeline triggered for go-sdk PR #211: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/211 — tests: retry-parity, idemp-flag, jitter-matrix.

DevQA: small ask — add `--debug-idemp` to CLI to print `Idempotency-Key` per attempt to stdout in dev mode. Makes repro easier for QA.

Omar S.: will add `--debug-idemp` and a `--jitter-seed` override for deterministic CI tests. Also adding metric `sdk.idemp.auto_count` and `sdk.retry.jitter_mode` to telemetry.

Claire H.: server-side suggestion: return `X-Redwood-Replay-Window-ms: 6000` in responses and server will keep soft-dedupe cache for that TTL. helps clients avoid replaying buffered ops older than the window.

Omar S.: noted. will coordinate with runtime team on header semantics. Also going to add a small safety net in CLI: if `--auto-idempotency` is OFF and no idemp header is present, warn loudly in stdout so onboarding teams don't accidentally produce duplicates.

BuildBot: go-sdk PR #211 build passed on matrix (seeds 13, 99, 7). Integration test shows duplicates reduced from 2.1% -> 0.02% with auto-idemp + full-jitter.

DevQA: QA will run an expanded matrix across node-sdk, go-sdk, CLI with `auto-idemp` toggled and jitter modes [full,equal,none]. ETA: 12h.

Claire H.: thanks — I'll hold off flipping CLI default until QA completes but plan to enable `--auto-idempotency` in the onboarding pipeline asap. :white_check_mark:
